svg.title: Chapter 4: Carrying
svg.desc: Chapter 4's card: an overcast afternoon a step greyer, the numbered cedar posts 16 to 19 along the road, and 17 pulled and lying across the camp table beside the hole it left, chalk marks on the wood for where it will stand. Beside the picture, the map's green legend box keeps its height with 5 of its nine rows printed; Tam's pencil count underneath agrees.
